items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: He was a piano player. You knew him huh? Yeah he's dead he's dead a long time. He was working at Tom Anderson for a while. He was a heavy drinker. He played a nice piano. I remember him.

ctx.x: people when I first started around here in New Orleans they couldn't think of Bias. I just called me Buzzy. When I was around New York I could pick up Eastside Westside and play it fast then they got to calling me Buzzy around. Call me Buzzy. So it came to mind call me Buzzy. See my family they all got an extra name but they hung Bias. I named that my godfather. Do you have a zip code in Birmingham? Uh. Well don't worry if you can. Wait a minute. 35205. 35. 205.

Do you remember a man named F.B. Wise? He was a uh he hired musicians or something. What's your name? Wise? F.B. Wise? I don't know who that would be. No. I don't know. He made it. I don't know. A.F. Murray. You know it may have been somebody who hired you once and I find it in the Union Magazine. Herbert Ruscha. Ruscha. Ruscha. I don't know how you pronounce that. Oh and and Tom Zimmerman that was one. He was a piano player. You knew him huh? Yeah he's dead he's dead a long time. He was working
